notes.title: 27/08/15 - Streamline v2.0 released.
notes.content:
With the help of our community feedback we are happy to present to you v2.0 of Streamline, featuring more dynamic gameplay.

What's new:

Added a second layer of cubes above the starting platform.

Cubes have been made larger for a more running experience.

Cubes have been given a certain amount of HP which is different depending on the difficulty being played.

Double jump aswell as a wallrunning has been added. (note that the wallrunning will only work on the large walls.)

We are happy with the results of these changes and we would like to thank you for being a part of Streamline's development. 

Happy gaming!
